scientific_integrity: Exact algebra and standard iterated-function-system dimension theorems; the independent numerical checker provides finite supplementary tests only. No independent external verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Equal-probability iid runs with durations tau or 2 tau, strict alternation and athermal harmonic forcing; dimension of the event-time measure is stated only in the strict separation regime. The physical-time distribution is shown to have bounded density but its formula is not derived. Publication priority is qualified by possible unindexed equivalent work.
title: A golden-ratio Cantor transition in the switching positions of a harmonically trapped renewal swimmer
